name: keka
description: Memory for Claude Code — plus guardrails and conventions: a session brief that compounds, named sessions with author/role/branch identity, automatic branch recall, encrypted team handoff over git with private trust, /recall search, a /partners tool catalog, a prompt coach, a secrets guard, and /stack + /patterns + /onboard for team conventions. Zero runtime dependencies.

brief_chars.title: Session brief size (chars)
brief_chars.description: Max characters of memory injected at session start. The DB is unbounded; this caps only the auto-injected brief.

learn.title: Session-end learning compression
learn.description: One Haiku call per session distills a summary and 0-3 durable learnings into memory. Requires `claude` on PATH.

partners.title: Partner tool recommendations
partners.description: ask: /partners recommends, you pick what installs. auto: a missing partner may be installed when a task needs it (you are told each time). off: silence.

coach.title: Prompt coach
coach.description: Free regex hints on vague prompts (name the file, state what done looks like). User-facing only; nothing is injected into the model's context.

plan_review.title: Plan-mode prompt review
plan_review.description: In plan mode only: one Haiku call scores the prompt /10 and suggests a rewrite. Requires `claude` on PATH; backs off for an hour after a failure.

guard.title: Secrets guard
guard.description: Blocks tool calls carrying real credentials (AWS/GitHub/Slack keys, private keys) and asks before secret-ish outbound payloads or credential-file reads. Fails open, logged.

seed_auto.title: Keep the team seed current
seed_auto.description: Refresh .keka/team-seed.jsonl on /compact, /clear and after each commit. Only ever touches a seed that already exists — running /handoff once is the opt-in. Never stages or commits anything.

default_trust.title: Trust for teammates you have not rated
default_trust.description: full: imported memories rank like your own. workspace: held privately with capped confidence until you raise them. Per-teammate trust is set with /team and stays on this machine.
